title: Amoytiinul qununteh tan astak naharal
intro: Ta cuumi yafdigoonuh dirkissah tan maritteh assakat le safar qammaala. Revelation galitteh addat, nabiyyi lih yangooroweenim inkih tan agat qagitak weeloysaanam xiqan abbobti suge. Tama muuci baxxole qarkaytoh miraacisak sugeeh, dumaahi qaadoodi miraacisak sugeeh, ilaa qaadik tan uddur qibaadah numma nammayak inkih miraaciinu kee amoytiinul milaagime. atu ta assakat le roocih kinnaane fakkiimele kay aydaadi holholwa qaadik taniimii kee addâ xexxar?
clues: Anu ni caxaaxuwih buxaaxi kee fayyale daalatal yamixxigeh tan xer leeh amol leeda le agat miraacisak suge.
Yi reeda fayyale caddol sugte, uxih kaxxa amoytiini ni mano kee kinnaane boodduh temeete.
Qunxa kimmir qaadik ane sinni farmo quukeeh, ciggiltah tan qaxmaqaane cayli wagittaamal luk sugeh an akkaloylitte inkih yiggileh.
Anu inni intiitak foocal milaagime qarkayto uble waqdi, Anu faxe raboyti tannah yan dudda alle waam eexegeh.
Anu qaduk yeybeleeleqeh inni xayyos qaran kee ardik inki rabbih, inkih cabeh anu inki adda tibbixeh massakaxxa luk.
Nanu, agat kinnuk, dumaahi ayroh qibaadak wadirih uduurra hayneh, kullim milaagtah tan numma oggolak sugne.

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
